message.content: The cover of Tempo magazine, dated "23-29 JUNI 2014," features a stylized illustration of a man with a light-brown complexion on a black background. He is shown from the chest up, facing right in profile. He has dark hair, a high forehead with visible lines, and dark eyes looking forward. He wears a light-colored, collared button-down shirt. His right hand is visible in the lower right, holding a rolled stack of papers. The papers, which have the word "OBOR" and part of "CAPRE" visible in red and black ink, are being consumed by orange and yellow flames at the top. On one page, a small photograph shows a person in a red garment. Large white text to the right reads "PRAHARA OBOR RAKYAT." The magazine's title, "TEMPO," appears in large, gray, serif letters at the top. Above it, white text includes "KORUPSI BUPATI BIAK NUMFOR," "INVESTIGASI: KAPAL ASING PENCURI IKAN," and "TRI RISMAHARINI TENTANG PENUTUPAN DOLLY." A barcode and price information, "RP 35.000," are in the bottom left corner.
